image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a grey whale's head and rostrum emerging from deep blue ocean water. The dorsal side of the head is visible, featuring characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. Two distinct blowholes are clearly visible at the top center of the rostrum. Water splashes around the base where the whale breaks the surface.
